Our task is to find A, B, and C such that 18−19x(2x+1)(3x−4)(x−2)=A2x+1+B3x−4+Cx−2.

Multiplying both sides by (2x+1)(3x−4)(x−2) gives

18−19x=A(3x−4)(x−2)+B(2x+1)(x−2)+C(2x+1)(3x−4).

For x=−12, we get 18−19(−12)=A(3(−12)−4)(−12−2)+B(2(−12)+1)(−12−2)+C(2(−12)+1)(3(−12)−4)552=554AA=2.

For x=43, we get 18−19(43)=A(3(43)−4)(43−2)+B(2(43)+1)(43−2)+C(2(43)+1)(3(43)−4)−223=−229BB=3.

For x=2, we get 18−19(2)=A(3(2)−4)(2−2)+B(2(2)+1)(2−2)+C(2(2)+1)(3(2)−4)−20=10CC=−2.

Therefore, 18−19x(2x+1)(3x−4)(x−2)=22x+1+33x−4−2x−2.
